dramatic_structure.goal: keep a three-zone delivery route readable
dramatic_structure.obstacle: each threshold hides the next room until crossed
dramatic_structure.stakes: the handoff cannot happen in the wrong service zone

locked_facts.value: The courier's trip from service corridor through stair landing to filter room occurs in continuous present time.
A blue door and a yellow stair rail are the two project-original waypoints that keep the three zones distinct.
The filter-room hatch is the required destination vector because the receiver waits beyond it.
